name: Terminology Guardrails
description: Anti-hallucination reference: correct vs incorrect terminology for life sciences CRM. Every agent must use target-platform terms when describing target-platform features.

rules.note: CLM is source-platform branding. Use 'Content Management' for the target platform. When discussing migration, qualify: 'migrating from CLM to Content Management'.
Approved Email is source-platform branding. Target module is 'Field Email'.
Source platform uses 'Calls'; target platform uses 'Visits'. This also affects data model: Call2_vod__c → Visit object.
Target platform uses 'Territory Alignment'. 'Enterprise Territory Management' is the underlying platform feature it's built on.
Call2_vod__c is a source-platform object. Target uses Visit standard object.
Source links samples to Calls. Target links samples to Visits. Migration MUST remap this relationship.
Source templates use Handlebars-like tokens. Target uses standard merge field syntax.
Target uses a hierarchical batch framework (Brand → Molecule → SKU). Source uses flat product-level caps.

wrong: CRM Analytics dashboards in source platform
rules.note: Source-platform AI features have different branding. Target uses 'Next Best' umbrella: Next Best Channel, Next Best Action, Next Best Message. Source-platform embedded analytics are replaced by CRM Analytics on the target platform.
In customer-facing Lumis content, use generic 'target platform' to stay vendor-neutral. Module names are specific enough for implementation guidance.
Source platform uses 'Call Plan' for structured HCP visit planning. Target platform uses 'Activity Plan', which supports visits, emails, and other engagement types beyond just calls.

Source platform defines numeric call frequency targets per account segment. Target platform uses hierarchical 'Activity Categories' with 'Activity Criteria' rules that define engagement frequency, channel mix, and prioritization.
Source platform uses 'Call Schedule' for daily/weekly planned calls. Target platform uses 'Visit Plan' for the same concept — the calendar view of scheduled HCP engagements.
Source platform tracks unsolicited medical questions as 'Medical Inquiries'. Target platform uses 'Medical Information Request' with a structured intake and response workflow.
